$comment: A fragment for ~/.config/kilo/kilo.json. `plugin` loads the tk gate from your clone (a folder with package.json; Kilo 7.8.18 plugin/shared.ts resolves it to src/plugin.ts); `permission` keeps Kilo's own prompts as a second layer for the tools that run or write (OpenCode's keys, which Kilo inherits). tk never writes a project-level kilo.json.
